annotation.title_en: Hiroshima Process International Guiding Principles for Advanced AI system
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission, DG CONNECT (Shaping Europe's digital future); G7 Hiroshima AI Process
annotation.summary_en: European Commission library page announcing the G7 Hiroshima Process International Guiding Principles for Organizations Developing Advanced AI Systems (30 October 2023), with a download link. The principles build on the OECD AI Principles to promote safe, secure and trustworthy advanced AI, including foundation models and generative AI. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Guiding principles aim to promote safe, secure and trustworthy advanced AI worldwide
They give guidance to organizations developing and using advanced AI, including foundation models and generative AI
They are a living, non-exhaustive document that builds on the OECD AI Principles
They apply to all AI actors across design, development, deployment and use
They come with a voluntary G7 Code of Conduct for AI developers
